description: This file contains low-level assembly code for setting and managing SRAM clocks on Realtek RTL838X hardware. It includes functions to start DRAM, set clock rates, and manage PLL configurations, primarily for hardware initialization and clock control.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Entry point to initialize DRAM start sequence on RTL838X.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the DRAM clock rate; adjusts PLL settings based on input parameters.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_size
methods.description: Symbol indicating the size of the DRAM, used as a reference for memory layout.
